free_tier.stated: EUR 6.00/month (HDD-1G): 1 core, 1,024 MB RAM, 512 GB HDD, 15,360 GB (15 TB) bandwidth, 1 Gbps port, IPv4 and IPv6, Amsterdam Netherlands. The vendor card quotes: 'HDD-1G', 'CPU 1 core', 'RAM 1 GB', 'HDD Storage 512 GB', 'Bandwidth 15 TB', and a price line of 6 in euros, monthly. The HDD ladder runs to HDD-16G at EUR 96 for 4 cores, 16 GB and 8,192 GB, and the NVMe line starts at EUR 8.00 for 2 GB and 40 GB.
free_tier.notes: the cart (clients.liteserver.nl, WHMCS) prices HDD-1G at EUR 6.00 monthly, EUR 17.28 quarterly (list 18.00), EUR 33.12 semi-annually (list 36.00), EUR 63.36 annually (list 72.00), EUR 120.96 biennially (list 144.00) and EUR 172.80 triennially (list 216.00), with EUR 0.00 setup and EUR 6.00 total due today on the monthly term; no renewal price is printed and the cart shows no out-of-stock marker

egress.terms: 15 TB a month included, then the port is limited to 10 Mbps for the rest of the calendar month instead of the machine being suspended; extra bandwidth sold at EUR 2.50 per 5 TB block
egress.price_per_tb: EUR 2.50 per 5 TB block, so EUR 0.50 per TB

record.interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
record.tooling: WHMCS cart at clients.liteserver.nl with per-plan add-ons for cores, RAM, HDD blocks and bandwidth blocks; no API is documented on the pages read; KVM with instant setup and a 24 hour manual verification window
record.chaining: 512 GB of HDD for EUR 6 is the largest disk on the cheapest plan among evaluated providers, and the throttle-instead-of-suspend policy makes it usable as a mirror target rather than a host that goes dark at the cap; 15 TB a month is about one full replication pass of the 10 TB active dataset, so it is a backup tier rather than a serving tier, and the 20 TB dataset does not fit on one such plan at all.

limits.value: 15 TB a month; on exhaustion the vendor throttles the port to 10 Mbps for the rest of the calendar month rather than suspending, and extra bandwidth is EUR 2.50 per 5 TB block. The 512 GB HDD and the single core are the other limits
